tagline: Discover local Korea in the order that fits you, not the order ads pay for
sample_notice: Demo sample data. Ratings, review counts, fees and hours are example values.
origin_current: Current location: your location (from your browser)
origin_outside: You are outside Jung-gu, Daejeon, so distances are measured from Jung-gu Office.
origin_located: Got your location. Distances will be measured from where you are (from Jung-gu Office if you are outside Jung-gu).
no_results: No places match. Try a wider distance or budget.
diversity_note: {k} places with the same main category rank above, so the score was multiplied by 0.9^{k}.
neutral_note: No Google data, so the neutral value 0.5 was used.
adjusted_rating_note: With fewer reviews, it is pulled toward the site average ({c}) (m = 5).
login_to_review: Log in to leave reviews and saves.
err_fields: Username must be 3+ characters and password 6+.
dashboard_free: Free visibility stats — no ad spend needed.
tip_no_views: No views yet. Adding a main photo and description helps you show up in searches.
tip_low_like_rate: Many views but few saves. Try improving your main photo and description.
tip_below_category: Views are below your category average. Add words visitors search for to your categories and description.
tip_foreign_majority: Most visitors are international. Consider English, Chinese and Japanese descriptions.
not_owner: Log in with a business account to view this.
